'''Bengely Four''' was a world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was settled by a group of [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonaks]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Kitonak colonists began to rapidly undergo a series of benign genetic mutations, the source of which was traced to a viral infection augmented by a rare chemical in the colony's air supply.<ref name="TOR" />
